title: Diagnose why the Docs entry now exists per component but shows nothing when opened
objective: Owner confirms a Docs entry now appears in the sidebar per component (Button > Docs, Default), matching the autodocs fix, but opening it shows nothing. Diagnose via server logs and direct HTTP checks of the docs iframe before changing anything further.
validations: DONE: reproduced the owner's exact report -- fetched the docs iframe directly and found a real console error in the Storybook dev server log: 'TypeError: docsParameter.renderer is not a function' (Vite Unhandled rejection), happening consistently, not just once.
DONE: ruled out stale cache as the cause -- cleared node_modules/.cache and .next entirely, fully restarted both servers, and the same error still reproduced.

DONE: traced the mechanism in @storybook/react-vite and @storybook/react's own preset.js (read directly): whether the docs renderer entry (entry-preview-docs) gets registered depends on `docsEnabled = Object.keys(docsConfig).length > 0` from `presets.apply('docs', ...)` -- config wiring looked correct on our end.

DONE: found via WebSearch a matching, currently open/recently-closed GitHub issue (storybookjs/storybook#33440) reporting the exact same error message ('docsParameter.renderer is not a function') on Storybook 10.1.11 with @storybook/react-vite -- confirmed this is a real upstream Storybook bug, not a misconfiguration in this repo, before proposing any further config changes.

SUPERSEDED: rather than continue chasing an upstream bug with no confirmed fix, escalated to the owner with the concrete finding; owner chose to render descriptions inline in the Canvas instead, continued as ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-INLINE-DESCRIPTIONS.
risks: storybookjs/storybook#33440 remains open/unresolved as of this session -- if a future Storybook upgrade is done in this repo, worth checking whether that issue was fixed and whether the Docs page (and the config added in ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-AUTODOCS: docs.autodocs/tags) then starts working correctly.
